candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the marked limit applies to total metal versus another metal fraction or speciation would change which reported measurements are paired with an enforceable numeric limit and whether a comparison is applicable.

candidates.exact_span: It is advised that the influent and effluent samples are collected considering flow detention time through each plant.
candidates.computation_change_reason: If this advisory is read as a binding sampling-timing condition versus non-operative guidance, it could change whether monitoring evidence is treated as required and adequate for a given period (B) or whether absent or mismatched samples are classified as documented no-data, inadequate evidence, or unresolved (C).

candidates.exact_span: Analytical MQLs should be used so that the data can also be used for Local Limits assessment and NPDES application purposes.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of the MQL requirement affects whether reported values below quantitation are treated as enforceable numeric results for limit comparison (A) and whether missing or non-quantified results are classified as ordinary numeric data, documented no-data, or unresolved missing-evidence cases (C).

candidates.exact_span: Maximum Allowable Headworks Loading limitation in ug/l.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The stated unit and headworks-loading limit type determine which numeric limit value and measurement unit apply for comparison; a different reading of the limit basis would change exceedance evaluation.

candidates.exact_span: Only complete for pollutants that have approved Technically Based Local Limits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a pollutant has an approved Technically Based Local Limit governs whether a headworks-loading numeric limit is applicable at all (A), whether related monitoring or reporting fields are required to be completed (B), and whether blank or missing entries reflect conditional non-applicability versus unresolved evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Daily average effluent limit in the NPDES permit OR the applicable state Water Quality Standard calculated to an equivalent permit effluent limit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The disjunctive source of the applicable limit—permit effluent limit versus WQS-derived equivalent—would change which enforceable numeric value is selected for daily-average comparisons and thus whether a measurement exceeds the applicable limit.

candidates.exact_span: Record names of any pollutants [40 CFR 122, Appendix D, Table II and/or Table V] detected and the quantity in which they were detected.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which detected pollutants fall within the cited CFR tables, and whether recording name and quantity is a required monitoring/reporting obligation, affects which monitoring requirements are deemed applicable (B) and how detected-but-unreported or partially reported results are classified among documented states versus missing evidence (C).
